_usage: Copy to config.json, fill in your values, then run: python tableau_assessment_extractor.py --config config.json

_notes.pg_host: Use 'localhost' when running on the Tableau Server machine itself. For remote access, SSH-tunnel first: ssh -L 15432:localhost:8060 tableau-server
_notes.pg_port: Tableau Server's dedicated internal Postgres port. Default 8060. Verify with: tsm configuration get -k pgsql.port
_notes.pg_user: The built-in read-only user. On Tableau Server 2019+ this is often 'readonly'. On older versions try 'tblwgadmin'. Check with: tsm configuration get -k pgsql.readonly_username
_notes.batch_size: Number of workbooks fetched per SQL round-trip. Reduce to 20 if memory is limited; increase to 200 on fast servers.
_notes.log_level: INFO for production. Use DEBUG to see per-workbook XML parse details.
